scenes.title: Enclave · frontend and backend
scenes.detail: A real local gateway, database and blockchain. NEAR supplies the remote GPU inference.

scenes.title: Connected to the workspace
scenes.detail: The model, payment mode, policy and history come from the backend. The gateway remains in development mode.

scenes.title: The active model
scenes.detail: The registry identifies the approved model and serving-code hashes. Requests use the gateway's configured model.

scenes.title: Set a spending mandate
scenes.detail: This agent can use the active model and spend up to 0.20 test USDC per day.

scenes.title: Send an encrypted request
scenes.detail: The browser encrypts the prompt with AES-256-GCM. The agent mandate is checked by the gateway.

scenes.title: Payment is explicit
scenes.detail: HTTP 402 produces a payment challenge. This demonstration settles test USDC on local chain 31337.

scenes.title: NEAR inference is running
scenes.detail: The gateway checks provider evidence. The browser will decrypt the response and verify its receipt.

scenes.title: Response received and verified
scenes.detail: The response, input/output hashes and EIP-712 signature match. The text below is the live model output.

scenes.title: Inspect the signed receipt
scenes.detail: The receipt binds model, serving code, input and output hashes. Signature verification is separate from hardware attestation.

scenes.title: Anchored on the local chain
scenes.detail: The worker submitted a real local-chain transaction. Its hash is stored with the receipt.

scenes.title: Payment and usage history
scenes.detail: Payment status, amount and settlement transaction are read from the database; no browser-generated usage data.

scenes.title: Export an audit record
scenes.detail: The export contains loaded receipt and payment metadata. Prompt text, model answers and credentials are excluded.

scenes.title: History survives a page reload
scenes.detail: The API key is held only in memory, so reconnecting is required. Backend records remain available.

scenes.title: Frontend and backend, connected
scenes.detail: Live NEAR inference · encrypted prompts and responses · signed receipts · persistent history · local test settlement.
